name: Vanaja Tayaloor
title: AI Engineer
tagline: Building AI-powered products, and the people who ship them.
bio:
I'm a software architect turned AI engineer, with two decades spent designing systems before spending the last few years applying that experience to machine learning, generative AI, and the products built on top of them.

I believe learning is the most important skill anyone can build — which is why, alongside engineering, I run **OjasaMirai**, a learning platform that has already helped 150+ learners pick up in-demand skills faster, backed by a custom VS Code extension for hands-on, in-editor practice.

I care about the intersection of technology, psychology, and hands-on craft: not just building models and systems, but building the tools and environments that help people actually learn and use them.
